<thought>We need a template that can retrosynthetically disconnect a sulfonamide into an amine and a sulfonyl chloride. The functional group formed in the forward reaction is a sulfonamide, which in the database is listed as “sulfonamides”. We'll search the template catalog for templates applicable to benzenesulfonamide (SMILES: c1ccc(cc1)S(=O)(=O)N) that form a sulfonamide, create an S‑N bond, and break an S‑Cl bond.</thought>
